<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 260" width="900" height="260" shape-rendering="crispEdges" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="typeclip">
      <rect x="290" y="50" height="110" width="0">
        <animate attributeName="width" values="0;560;560;0" keyTimes="0;0.55;0.92;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- sky -->
  <rect width="900" height="260" fill="#79c0ff"/>
  <rect y="120" width="900" height="80" fill="#8fcbff"/>

  <!-- sun -->
  <rect x="790" y="24" width="44" height="44" fill="#ffe66d"/>
  <rect x="798" y="32" width="28" height="28" fill="#fff3a3"/>

  <!-- clouds -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.95">
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="30" width="80" height="16"/><rect x="16" y="14" width="48" height="16"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-120,0;960,0" dur="45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="80" width="64" height="12"/><rect x="12" y="68" width="36" height="12"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-100,0;960,0" dur="60s" begin="-25s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ground -->
  <rect y="200" width="900" height="16" fill="#5da130"/>
  <rect y="200" width="900" height="4" fill="#7bc043"/>
  <rect y="216" width="900" height="44" fill="#866043"/>
  <g fill="#6f4e35">
    <rect x="30" y="224" width="16" height="16"/><rect x="120" y="240" width="16" height="16"/>
    <rect x="260" y="226" width="16" height="16"/><rect x="380" y="242" width="16" height="16"/>
    <rect x="510" y="224" width="16" height="16"/><rect x="640" y="238" width="16" height="16"/>
    <rect x="770" y="226" width="16" height="16"/><rect x="860" y="242" width="16" height="16"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#7f7f7f">
    <rect x="80" y="232" width="12" height="12"/><rect x="330" y="236" width="12" height="12"/>
    <rect x="580" y="230" width="12" height="12"/><rect x="820" y="234" width="12" height="12"/>
  </g>

  <!-- scrolling scenery (makes her look like she's walking) -->
  <g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="152" width="16" height="48" fill="#6b4a2b"/>
      <rect x="-24" y="104" width="64" height="48" fill="#3f8f2e"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="88" width="32" height="16" fill="#4fa83b"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="960,0;-120,0" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="152" width="16" height="48" fill="#6b4a2b"/>
      <rect x="-24" y="104" width="64" height="48" fill="#3f8f2e"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="88" width="32" height="16" fill="#4fa83b"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="960,0;-120,0" dur="12s" begin="-6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="184" width="4" height="16" fill="#3f8f2e"/>
      <rect x="-4" y="176" width="12" height="8" fill="#e63946"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="960,0;-40,0" dur="8s" begin="-2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="184" width="4" height="16" fill="#3f8f2e"/>
      <rect x="-4" y="176" width="12" height="8" fill="#ffd166"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="960,0;-40,0" dur="8s" begin="-6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- character -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="150,72;150,69;150,72" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- long hair (back), sways a little -->
    <g>
      <rect x="-20" y="-2" width="40" height="70" fill="#3a2214"/>
      <rect x="-20" y="60" width="12" height="8" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
      <rect x="8" y="60" width="12" height="8" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="2 0 0;-2 0 0;2 0 0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- back arm -->
    <g>
      <rect x="-32" y="36" width="16" height="44" fill="#f0bd97"/>
      <rect x="-32" y="36" width="16" height="12" fill="#a45ed6"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="30 -24 38;-30 -24 38;30 -24 38" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- legs -->
    <g>
      <rect x="-16" y="80" width="16" height="48" fill="#f0bd97"/>
      <rect x="-16" y="116" width="16" height="12" fill="#5a3b7a"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-28 -8 80;28 -8 80;-28 -8 80" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="0" y="80" width="16" height="48" fill="#f7c9a6"/>
      <rect x="0" y="116" width="16" height="12" fill="#6c4a8f"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="28 8 80;-28 8 80;28 8 80" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- top + skirt -->
    <rect x="-16" y="32" width="32" height="44" fill="#b56ee8"/>
    <rect x="-16" y="32" width="32" height="4" fill="#d29bf5"/>
    <rect x="-20" y="68" width="40" height="22" fill="#ff8fc0"/>
    <rect x="-20" y="84" width="40" height="6" fill="#ff6fa8"/>

    <!-- head -->
    <rect x="-16" y="0" width="32" height="32" fill="#f7c9a6"/>
    <!-- hair front: top, fringe, sides -->
    <rect x="-16" y="0" width="32" height="8" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
    <rect x="-16" y="8" width="8" height="4" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
    <rect x="8" y="8" width="8" height="4" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
    <rect x="-16" y="8" width="4" height="30" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
    <rect x="12" y="8" width="4" height="30" fill="#4b2e1a"/>
    <!-- bow -->
    <rect x="6" y="-6" width="14" height="10" fill="#ff4d94"/>
    <rect x="10" y="-2" width="6" height="4" fill="#ffd1e6"/>
    <!-- eyes with lashes -->
    <rect x="-12" y="14" width="8" height="2" fill="#2b1a10"/>
    <rect x="-12" y="16" width="8" height="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="-8" y="16" width="4" height="4" fill="#8e44ad"/>
    <rect x="4" y="14" width="8" height="2" fill="#2b1a10"/>
    <rect x="4" y="16" width="8" height="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="4" y="16" width="4" height="4" fill="#8e44ad"/>
    <!-- blush + smile -->
    <rect x="-12" y="22" width="4" height="2" fill="#ff9aa8"/>
    <rect x="8" y="22" width="4" height="2" fill="#ff9aa8"/>
    <rect x="-4" y="26" width="8" height="2" fill="#c0575e"/>
    <rect x="-6" y="24" width="2" height="2" fill="#c0575e"/>
    <rect x="4" y="24" width="2" height="2" fill="#c0575e"/>

    <!-- front arm -->
    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="36" width="16" height="44" fill="#f7c9a6"/>
      <rect x="16" y="36" width="16" height="12" fill="#b56ee8"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-30 24 38;30 24 38;-30 24 38" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- typed text -->
  <g clip-path="url(#typeclip)" font-family="'Courier New', Courier, monospace" font-weight="bold">
    <text x="290" y="92" font-size="38" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="6" paint-order="stroke">Hi, I'm Sharanya</text>
    <text x="290" y="132" font-size="20" fill="#ffe66d" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="5" paint-order="stroke">backend * blockchain * DSA</text>
  </g>
</svg>
